def: Using neural models, usually LLMs, to generate formal proofs that a proof assistant then checks, so every accepted proof is guaranteed valid.
practice: Benchmarks include miniF2F and PutnamBench; DeepSeek-Prover-V2 reached 88.9% on miniF2F-test and solved 49 of 658 PutnamBench problems in April 2025, and scores move fast, so date them.
